scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the same after-work Zahnd bouldering approach with the crash pad after the group has already left the car.
Emerging Need: The approach stops at the check-in table when Gray Session pad’s shoulder buckle snaps, and the pad cannot be carried loose past the volunteer line.
Decision Context: Early notices only set ordinary trailhead rules; once the strap failure occurs, a useful fix depends on Julian’s saved packing note rather than staff loaners.
Consequence: If the packed strap details are unavailable before the gate table closes, the group must abandon the pad-dependent bouldering plan.

parameter.title: Zahnd after-work bouldering circuit
parameter.description: Meet Nora after work, carry the Gray Session pad from the Zahnd WMA trailhead pullout, and try the short evening circuit before dusk.
parameter.location: Zahnd WMA trailhead pullout and Zahnd boulders

parameter.subject: Zahnd trailhead pad check rules for tonight
parameter.body: Tonight's volunteer table will check that crash pads are secured before parties leave the Zahnd WMA trailhead pullout. Please do not send personal repair notes before in-person sign-in; volunteers evaluate gear at the table and cannot pre-approve fixes remotely.

parameter.content: We parked at Zahnd WMA trailhead, signed in, and started up the approach with the Gray Session pad and my small pad. Table says we're clear as long as the gear stays secured.

Back at the table. On the first switchback the Gray Session shoulder buckle snapped, and the volunteer won't let a loose pad past the line. Julian is digging through the blue duffel but doesn't remember where he packed any spare strap.

parameter.subject: Loose-pad holds close at 5:45
parameter.body: For signed-in parties already at Zahnd WMA trailhead: unsecured crash pads may continue only after a personal strap repair is shown at the table by 5:45 p.m. We do not loan straps or search bags; after 5:45 no new bouldering starts will be released from the pullout.

parameter.content: The table just closed the repair window and marked us signed out without the Gray pad. We're walking back to the cars, so the Zahnd circuit is off tonight.
